test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following information is necessary to construct a rectangle?

options.text: Only the length of the diagonal
Length of one side and the area of the rectangle
Only the length of one side

solution:
The correct answer is __Length of two adjacent sides__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A rectangle__ is a quadrilateral with opposite sides equal and all angles equal to 90 degrees.
 
• To construct a rectangle, the length of two adjacent sides is necessary.
 
• Knowing the length of two adjacent sides allows for the creation of the remaining sides due to symmetry.
 
• Other information like diagonal length or area can provide partial data, but adjacent sides are essential for construction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Diagonal Information:**

 
 
• The diagonal provides information about the relationship between the sides but cannot alone construct the rectangle.
 
 
 
• **Area and One Side:**
 
 
• Knowing the area and one side gives the length of the other side but does not provide orientation.
 
 
 
• **Single Side Information:**
 
 
• The length of one side alone is insufficient to construct a rectangle.
